title: Unfolded sound selectors
summary: Replaces the interval and rhythm sound dropdowns with always-visible segmented waveform buttons.

title: Selectable interval timbres
summary: Adds pure sine, warm triangle and bright square sound choices—with waveform symbols—to the interval trainer.

title: Rhythm sound palette
summary: Adds three selectable rhythm-recognition sounds: a dry click, warm wood tone and softer sustained tone.

title: Printable A5 songbooks
summary: Groups every stored musical idea by song and generates one print-ready, multi-page A5 document per song.

title: Tool launcher and complete intervals
summary: Adds the functionality landing page, complete chromatic interval training, clearer quiz feedback and public version history.

title: Clearer quiz audio and notation
summary: Separates count-in and rhythm timbres, raises interval volume and introduces conventional one-line rhythm engraving.

title: Training quizzes
summary: Introduces interval recognition, rhythm dictation and rhythm-reading tap exercises with responsive layouts.

title: Conventional rhythm transcription
summary: Infers musical note values from tap spacing and consolidates rests instead of printing every empty grid cell.

title: Mobile metronome audio
summary: Unlocks Web Audio reliably on mobile and adds an audible accented metronome with a sound control.

title: Interactive rhythm capture
summary: Adds tempo, count-in, touch tapping, quantization, playback, live Verovio engraving and MusicXML download.

title: Notation sketchbook
summary: Establishes structured musical sketches, automated MusicXML, SVG and PNG rendering, manifests and the score gallery.
